description: This file serves as the client entry point for a Remix application. It handles hydration of the React app on the client side by rendering the RemixBrowser component within React's StrictMode, using React DOM's hydrateRoot function.

methods.name: startTransition
methods.description: Initiates a React transition, allowing for non-urgent updates without blocking user interaction.

methods.name: hydrateRoot
methods.description: Hydrates a React component tree into a DOM container, replacing any existing content.
